description: Weight indicator (ISIS) with Modbus: gross, tare and net weight, status flags and the remote key
source: SIPEL Indicador ISIS, Manual de Uso e Instalación, Rev. 3.0

sources.title: Manual de Uso e Instalación, Indicador ISIS
sources.note: Section 3.4, Modbus; attached by the requester to issue #523

notes: Modbus RTU or ASCII, functions 03 (read) and 06 (write one register), on RS-232 (one indicator) or RS-485/RS-422 (several). Set in the PORT 1 menu: ID = slave number 0 to 99, R1 = 3 (PLC), B1 = 0 to 3 for 1200, 2400, 4800 or 9600 baud (factory 3), H1 = 0, F1 = 0 for RTU 8N1 or 1 for ASCII 7 bits, 2 stop bits.
Weights are 32-bit integers in two registers, without decimal point; the word order is not stated, high word first is assumed.
Writing the key register is switched off at the factory: set JC = 1 in the ESTAB menu.
Written from the manufacturer's manual (Spanish); not tested on a device.

registers.name: Flags
registers.description: Bit field, the sum of the flag values: 1 display negative, 2 centre of zero, 4 motion, 8 net mode, 16 gross negative, 128 zero capture inhibited

registers.name: Key
registers.description: Writing this register emulates a key; it must be enabled with JC=1 in the ESTAB menu (not covered by the Argentine approval of the indicator)
